messages.text: I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Fixed reduced-motion support for the card border transition and win banner pulse. Changing the system preference while the game is open takes effect immediately.

The build, type checks, 138 unit tests, and all three motion browser tests passed. The full browser suite passed 76 checks; one unrelated face-sheet test timed out, including when rerun on its own. The repository-wide formatting check also reports three unrelated files; the changed files pass formatting.
